prompt.text:
Repair the buggy source below without changing the required API.

File contract: Return Solution.java defining public final class Solution.
Required API: public static String escapeLogFields(List<String> fields)
Behavior: Serialize fields separated by a literal tab. Inside each field escape backslash as \\, tab as \t, LF as \n, and CR as \r, in that precedence. An empty list serializes to the empty string.
Visible example: Fields ["a<TAB>b", "c\d"] serialize as a\tb<TAB>c\\d, where <TAB> denotes a literal tab.

Buggy source to repair:

import java.util.*; public final class Solution { public static String escapeLogFields(List<String>f){return String.join("\t",f);} }

reference.code: import java.util.*; public final class Solution { public static String escapeLogFields(List<String>f){var out=new ArrayList<String>();for(String v:f)out.add(v.replace("\\","\\\\").replace("\t","\\t").replace("\n","\\n").replace("\r","\\r"));return String.join("\t",out);} }
